briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race toward multimodal AGI benchmarks amid escalating compute arms race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases as regulatory scrutiny mounts. Compute shortages persist while safety concerns grow around autonomous agents. The AI race intensifies with new national initiatives from US, China and EU.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o4 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus; Google unveils Gemini 3 with native video generation; Meta open-sources Llama 4; xAI trains Colossus-2; DeepSeek launches R2.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. New multi-agent attacks reported in enterprise deployments. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for automotive, IoT and BCI.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell B200 at scale; Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100 clusters; TSMC ramps 2nm production for AI chips; Saudi Arabia commits $40B to sovereign AI infrastructure.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first superintelligent system emerge from a Western or Chinese lab by 2028?
